title: Pest Control Treatment Completion Report
subtitle: Residential Pest-Control Treatment: verifies results and open follow-up.
description: Pest Control Treatment Completion Report covers target pest, activity zone, entry point, treatment location, and contributing condition. The residential pest-service coordinator records Residential Pest-Control Treatment performed work, tests, limits, and acceptance. Pest Control Treatment Completion Report keeps Residential Pest-Control Treatment exceptions visible until the residential pest-service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Pest Control Treatment Completion Report at residence, room, exterior perimeter, attic, crawlspace, and occupied area. Document target pest, activity zone, entry point, treatment location, and contributing condition identity before Residential Pest-Control Treatment begins. Compare target pest, activity zone, entry point, treatment location, and contributing condition findings with stated Residential Pest-Control Treatment criteria; route unresolved Residential Pest-Control Treatment issues to licensed or otherwise qualified pest-control reviewer. For Pest Control Treatment Completion Report, confirm requirements for Residential Pest-Control Treatment. Ask licensed or otherwise qualified pest-control reviewer to review Residential Pest-Control Treatment conditions beyond the residential pest-service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Completion parties and source record
sections.guidance: For Residential Pest-Control Treatment, identify responsible parties, residence, room, exterior perimeter, attic, crawlspace, and occupied area, and the linked target pest, activity zone, entry point, treatment location, and contributing condition source.

fields.label: Occupant, pet, sensitive-area, and prior-treatment context

sections.title: Performed scope and verification results
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Pest-Control Treatment facts for target pest, activity zone, entry point, treatment location, and contributing condition; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential Pest-Control Treatment completion checks
items: Activity evidence, count, location, and freshness
Entry, moisture, food, waste, and harborage condition
Device or treatment placement and accessibility
Occupant, child, pet, food, and water exposure boundary
Sanitation, exclusion, and structural action needed

sections.title: Verified outcome and customer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Resolve open Residential Pest-Control Treatment conditions; have residential pest-service coordinator assign the next Residential Pest-Control Treatment owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Limitations, open work, and retained evidence
items: Target pest cannot be reliably identified
Occupied-area or non-target exposure cannot be controlled
Required preparation or vacancy not completed
Structural or sanitation cause prevents effective treatment
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Pest-Control Treatment when identification, exposure control, required preparation, or a contributing condition remains unresolved. Retain the available Residential Pest-Control Treatment proof and route unresolved target pest, activity zone, entry point, treatment location, and contributing condition scope to residential pest-service coordinator.
